name: promo-dialog
title: Promo dialog
description: The loudest surface, in three presentations: a centred dialog, a split image-and-copy layout for launches, and a full-screen story that only opens when the visitor asks. A swipe-down sheet on phones.
docs: Requires Base UI 1.8+ (a base-* shadcn project): the phone layout uses the Base UI Drawer for swipe dismissal.
